results.schoolVerdict: Tajika: indicative annual reading for CAREER via Varsha Kundali methodology. [VARSHA_KUNDALI_PENDING] — full Tajika precision requires the 2026 Varsha Kundali (solar return ~Jan 25 2026, Bhubaneswar) computed via Swiss Ephemeris. Current scoring uses natal chart proxies with reduced confidence weights (0.35–0.50). The Tajika framework reads annual trends through Ithasala/Ishrafa aspect patterns, Sahama (Arabic parts) positions, Varshesha (annual lord), and Muntha progression. Domain score 3.25/5.0 should be treated as directional, not precise.
